data.gender_notes: Parthiv is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Parthiv is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Parvat', meaning 'mountain'. Parthiv means 'son of earth'. The name Parthiv carries the meaning “Son of Earth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Parthiv usually hope their child will grow to embody son of earth and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Parthiv total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Parthiv was a king mentioned in the Mahabharata, an ancient Indian epic. The name Parthiv carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Parthiv was the king of Haihayas and was a great warrior. He was a grand father of Bhishma Pitamaha, the grandsire of the Pandava and Kaurava princes.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Parthiv was also mentioned as the name of a planet in Hindu astronomy. The name Parthiv carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: In Hindu astronomy, Parthiv is one of the Navagrahas or nine planets. It is identified with Mercury.
